decisions.reason: Although this consumer-facing drink mix is less central to the firm's waste-to-energy and industrial technology focus, it is still very new and relatively inexpensive to keep on offer while the firm learns about demand.
These modular plant extensions fit the core business well, can leverage existing engineering capabilities across several models, and are worth keeping as a low-regret option in a growing market.

As a flagship waste-oil-to-energy plant with its own page and strong strategic fit, it should be retained because the firm is unlikely to abandon a core option before more market and technical information arrives.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is strategically important and close to the established offer, so despite technical and commercialization uncertainty the firm would likely keep this option open for another year.
